DONNELLY, (Lucan, Co. Dublin and formerly of Ringsend and the Revenue Commissioners) November 5th, 2014 (peacefully) in the loving care of the staff at Our Lady’s Hospice, Harold’s Cross. John (Sean), beloved husband of Eithne and dear father of John, Sheila, Niamh and Barry; Sadly missed by his loving wife, sons, daughters, grandchildren Jessica, James, Harry, Charlie, Freddie and Tilly, sons-in-law Dean and Gerry, daughter-in-law Jacqui, brother, sister, brothers-in-law, sisters-in-law, relatives and friends.

 

Reposing at Cunningham’s Funeral Home, Chapel Hill, Lucan on Thursday evening between 6pm and 8pm. Removal to St. Mary’s Church, Lucan on Friday morning arriving for Requiem Mass at 10am followed by burial in Esker Cemetery. Family flowers only please. Donations, if desired, to Our Lady’s Hospice, Harold’s Cross.

 

Rest in Peace
